items: Mazboot hai, aasani se nahi toot'ta, aur ragar (rubbing) aur ghisaav (wear and tear) bardasht karta hai.
Elasticity (lachak) ki wajah se khinch jata hai.
Is ki satah phisalne wali hai, is liye friction (ragar) kam karti hai.
Aam tor par teil, kai solvents (ghol banane wale maadde) aur alkalis is par asar nahi karte.
Is ka melting point (pighalne ka darja) zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: Nylon ki kaun si properties ise gears aur bearings ke liye munasib banati hain?
blocks.explanation: Is ki mazbooti aur ghisaav bardasht karne ki salahiyat, aur is ki phisalne wali satah jo friction kam karti hai.

items: Nylon: mazboot, lachakdar, kam friction, teil aur alkalis se mehfooz, zyada melting point.
